behavior: Each run owns a unique timestamp/random directory under app/captures/verify-suite. result.json is atomically replaced at start, each step, and completion; pending runs have ok:null. Each subprocess has complete streamed stdout/stderr files, bounded legacy tails, exit/timeout/error, start/end/time. Git commit/dirty/worktree content hash is captured at both run boundaries. Shared child report/capture ownership is explicitly unverified.

red.failure_kind: New durable-run and source-identity entry points absent; existing 13 tests pass. Initial RED is feature-absence evidence, not a live subprocess/model failure.

new_regressions: in-progress state and final real result/log files
nonzero subprocess exit preserves previous step
timeout with late close(0) preserves failure
synchronous spawn failure records failed step
child error event records failed step
two runs preserve prior run bytes; stale successful shared artifacts cannot flip current failure
different start/end source snapshots reported honestly
real filesystem log-write failure makes exit0 insufficient

cli_smoke.command: cd app; node scripts/run-verify-suite.js --suite paper --only verify:paper-manifest
assertions: first two final JSON keys remain ok/results
step code0 and actual stdout/stderr files exist
file content ends with recorded tails

limits: ok retains subprocess success meaning, with log-write failure also preventing a false success receipt; it does not attest shared child captures/reports.

Source comparison is two boundary snapshots, not continuous file locking or monitoring. If Git/source reading fails, the error and unavailable hash are explicit; sourceSnapshotsMatch cannot become true without a hash.
Default source hashing excludes Git-ignored files such as .env, dependencies, generated captures and profiles. It identifies the nonignored working copy, not its entire runtime environment.
No live model, broker or order operation, no Electron/UI probe was invoked. The real CLI smoke runs only a static local manifest check.
No commit/push by this writer. Root owns integration and independent review.
